title: Automated GenFind V3 Blood/serum DNA extraction
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates the GenFind V3 protocol from Beckman Coulter for [DNA isolation from whole blood or serum with magnetic particles](https://s3.amazonaws.com/pf-upload-01/u-4256/0/2022-01-24/kz234fm/C36038AB.pdf). This protocol utilizes a P300-Multi channel pipette Gen2 (and optionally a p300-Single channel pipette Gen2) and gives the user the option to select a variable number of samples (Ideally a multiple of 8 for efficient use of reagents) and whether to dispense liquid waste in a 1-well reservoir in slot 6 or in the fixed trash container. The user can also choose whether they want to use Proteinase K and elution buffer from a tube-rack rather than the 12 well reservoir. ßThis protocol is designed for holding the samples on the [USA Scientific PlateOne® Deep 96-Well 2 mL Polypropylene Plate (P/N 1896-2800)](https://www.usascientific.com/plateone-96-deep-well-2ml/p/PlateOne-96-Deep-Well-2mL) on a 2nd generation Magnetic module. The purified samples are transferred to a [Abgene™ 96 Well 0.8mL Polypropylene Deepwell Storage Plate (Thermo AB-0859)](https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/AB0859) in the final step. The protocol uses the [NEST 12 Well Reservoir 15 mL](https://shop.opentrons.com/nest-12-well-reservoirs-15-ml/) and the [NEST 1 Well Reservoir 195 mL](https://shop.opentrons.com/nest-1-well-reservoirs-195-ml/) as sources of reagents. All reagents except the two wash buffers (Wash WBB and Wash WBC are stored either in the twelve well reservoir or the tube rack) The protocol is broken down into 5 main parts: * Lysis buffer and proteinase K is added to the samples. The protocol is paused and the samples are incubated until the user is ready to continue. The pause allows the user to resuspend the magnetic particles in Bind BBB before adding the solution to the twelve well reservoir. * Bind BBB is added and the samples are incubated in order to bind DNA in the lysed solution. * The supernatant is discarded and the beads are washed two times wit

steps.title: Set up deck and select options
steps.instruction: Load the Opentrons deck with a USA Scientific PlateOne Deep 96‑Well 2 mL plate (P/N 1896‑2800) on a 2nd‑generation magnetic module, a Thermo AB‑0859 96‑well 0.8 mL storage plate for final DNA, a NEST 12‑well 15 mL reservoir (and optionally a NEST 1‑well 195 mL reservoir in slot 6 for waste), and place Proteinase K, elution buffer, Lysis LBB, Bind BBB, Wash WBB and Wash WBC in the 12‑well reservoir or a tube rack as chosen. Select the number of samples (ideally a multiple of 8), the waste destination (1‑well reservoir or fixed trash), and whether Proteinase K and elution buffer are taken from the tube rack. Use a P300‑Multi‑channel Gen2 pipette (or a P300‑Single‑channel Gen2 if preferred).

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and proteinase K
steps.instruction: Dispense the required volume of Lysis LBB into each sample well, then add Proteinase K to each well and mix the contents.

steps.title: Incubate lysed samples
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol; incubate the lysed samples for either 10 min at 37 °C or 30 min at room temperature, then resume when the user confirms the incubation is complete.

steps.title: Resuspend and add Bind BBB
steps.instruction: Vortex or invert the Bind BBB tube until fully resuspended, then add the Bind BBB solution to well 4 (and well 5 if additional volume is required) of the 12‑well reservoir, and gently mix the samples.

steps.title: Incubate for DNA binding
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples for 5 min to allow DNA binding to the magnetic beads.

steps.title: Engage magnets for bead capture
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for 15 min to capture the beads.

steps.title: Discard supernatant to waste
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant from each well and dispense it into the selected waste receptacle (1‑well reservoir in slot 6 or the fixed trash).

steps.title: Wash beads with Wash WBB
steps.instruction: Wash the beads twice with Wash WBB: add Wash WBB, mix briefly, then aspirate and discard the supernatant each time.

steps.title: Wash beads with Wash WBC
steps.instruction: Wash the beads twice with Wash WBC: add Wash WBC, mix briefly, then aspirate and discard the supernatant each time.

steps.title: Add elution buffer and mix
steps.instruction: Add elution buffer to each sample well and mix gently.

steps.title: Incubate and remix eluate
steps.instruction: Incubate the eluate for 2 min, then remix the samples.

steps.title: Engage magnets and transfer DNA
steps.instruction: Engage the magnets for 5 min, then transfer the cleared supernatant containing purified DNA to the Abgene 96‑well 0.8 mL storage plate.
